otpDesc1: Confirm your arrival to record check-in and display the session pass code. This app build does not share your live location.
otpSharePrefix: Share this server-issued code in person with
otpShareSuffix: to verify the session start in the Companion app.
reportText: Companion didn't show up or looks different? Report Issue
secureCallMsg: This feature requires a telephony backend integration (e.g., Twilio/Exotel) to mask numbers, which is not yet implemented.

arrival.neverShareOtp: Never share this code over phone or chat. Only share it in person when you meet.
arrival.shareCodeWarning: This code verifies the session start. It does not initiate or release a payment.
